page_title: ALA 0-1 RMA | Alaves v Real Madrid 13/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+8' The game has begun to heat up. Santiago Mourino (Alaves) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
90+7' It's like he was asking for a caution. Thibaut Courtois (Real Madrid) receives a yellow card.
90+5' Cesar Soto Grado shows a yellow card to Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) for his blatant foul.
90+4' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) makes a strong challenge and Cesar Soto Grado blows for a foul.
90+3' Carlos Protesoni (Alaves) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+2' The referee signals a substitution. Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) is brought on as a substitute for Federico Valverde.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
89' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Jesus Owono easily makes the save.
88' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
87' What a great touch by Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
86' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
85' Pau Cabanes (Alaves) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Cesar Soto Grado blows for a foul.
83' Antonio Blanco comes off the pitch to be replaced by Carlos Protesoni (Alaves).
83' Eduardo Coudet prepares a substitution. Carles Alena is replaced by Pau Cabanes (Alaves).
81' Free kick. Real Madrid will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
80' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
79' Real Madrid keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
77' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) picks up a yellow card.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) replaces Fran Garcia.
76' Eduardo Coudet has decided to make a change. Moussa Diarra (Alaves) replaces Abdel Abqar.
76' The manager makes a subsitution with Ander Guevara (Alaves) coming on for Joan Jordan.
75' Jesus Owono (Alaves) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
75' The attendance is 19438.
74' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Real Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
73' This shall not pass! Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
72' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) goes for goal with a shot from long range, but the effort flies painfully wide of the right post.
70' RED card! Manu Sanchez (Alaves) can’t believe it as the referee orders him from the pitch following the VAR review.

69' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Manu Sanchez (Alaves), but referee Cesar Soto Grado must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
69' Dangerous play by Manu Sanchez (Alaves). Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul.
68' Alaves work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
68' Santiago Mourino (Alaves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
66' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) plays a through ball but overhits it.
65' 58:42 – the latest ball possession ratio.
64' Toni Martinez (Alaves) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the bottom left corner, but Thibaut Courtois is prepared and dives to thwart him.
63' Davide Ancelotti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) replacing Arda Guler.
62' Substitution. Rodrygo makes his way off the pitch and Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) comes on as his replacement.
61' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
60' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Carlos Martin as he is replaced by Toni Martinez (Alaves).
59' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
58' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
57' Thibaut Courtois makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Kike Garcia (Alaves) after a cross from the side.
56' Carlos Martin (Alaves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Cesar Soto Grado had an easy-decision to make.
54' The linesman points to the corner flag, Alaves are going to take it.
54' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Alaves win a corner.
53' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
52' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

51' Carlos Martin (Alaves) has a lack of options after running onto a pass, so shoots from long range. It's a decent effort low towards the middle of the goal, but Thibaut Courtois pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
50' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Kike Garcia (Alaves) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
49' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
48' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+6' Cesar Soto Grado has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
45+3' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
45+2' A cross into the box from Carlos Martin (Alaves) is cleared.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! There is a free kick near the sideline to Alaves.
43' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
42' Joan Jordan (Alaves) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
41' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul.
38' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) has to leave the pitch!

38' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid), but referee Cesar Soto Grado must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
38' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) gets a yellow card.
37' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Alaves was in an offside position.
36' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just wide of the left post.

34' 0 - 1 Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) scores one of the best goals in his career. His rocket of a shot from distance goes straight inside the left post. They will be showing this on every football show for some time to come.
33' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
31' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
30' Kike Garcia (Alaves) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
28' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) commits a foul and Cesar Soto Grado immediately signals a free kick.
27' Kike Garcia (Alaves) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
26' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
24' The ball goes out of play and Alaves have been awarded a corner kick.
24' The Alaves players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
22' Celebrations are cut short for Real Madrid as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review due to a foul in the build-up play.
20' The Real Madrid players halt their celebrations as referee Cesar Soto Grado makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
19' Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
19' Goal! Raul Asencio (Real Madrid) coolly slotted the ball past the goalkeeper.
18' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

17' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. The linesman makes the right call and Real Madrid will have a corner.
17' The ball is cleared after Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The linesman signals a throw-in for Real Madrid.
16' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

15' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Real Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner.
15' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
14' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
12' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
11' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
9' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Jesus Owono makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
8' Alaves are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
7' Real Madrid are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
6' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) commits a rough foul. Cesar Soto Grado stops the game and makes a call.
4' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
3' The resulting corner from Joan Jordan (Alaves) is cleared by the defence.
3' Carles Alena (Alaves) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. Alaves have been awarded a corner kick.
2' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) was too forceful with his tackle and Cesar Soto Grado interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Alaves get a free kick.
1' The match has just started.
Alaves will kick-off.
Cesar Soto Grado will officiate today.
